products.description:
Kit includes:

1x Ingco Cordless Angle Grinder 900W 115MM 20V

2x Ingco Li-Ion Battery Pack 20V (4.0AH)

1x Ingco Intelligent Charger 20V

5x Abrasive metal cutting disc (115mm)

1x Carry case

Ingco Cordless Angle Grinder 900W 115MM 20V

Product details:
- Brushless motor
- Voltage: 20V
- Max input power: 900W
- No-load speed: 3 000/6 000/9 000 rpm
- Disc diameter: 115 mm
- Spindle thread: M14 Ingco
- Li-Ion Battery Pack
- (20V
- 4.0AH)

Product Details:
- Voltage: 20V
- Lithium-Ion 4.0Ah battery
- LED battery power indicator
- Suitable for INGCO 20V multiple tools

Ingco Intelligent Charger

Product Details:
- Rated Input voltage: 220V-240V~50/60Hz
- Output voltage: 20V
- Charge current: 2A
- Rated Input power: 50W
- Charges 20V 2.0Ah battery in 1Hr
